Kingdom of Cusco.name: Manco Cápac
Kingdom of Cusco.note_zh: 传说中的君主，年代为传统推算。

Kingdom of Cusco.name: Sinchi Roca
Kingdom of Cusco.note_zh: 传说中的君主，年代为传统推算。

Kingdom of Cusco.name: Lloque Yupanqui
Kingdom of Cusco.note_zh: 传说中的君主，年代为传统推算。

Kingdom of Cusco.name: Mayta Cápac
Kingdom of Cusco.note_zh: 传说中的君主，年代为传统推算。

Kingdom of Cusco.name: Cápac Yupanqui
Kingdom of Cusco.note_zh: 传说中的君主，年代为传统推算。

Kingdom of Cusco.name: Inca Roca
Kingdom of Cusco.note_zh: 传说中的君主，年代为传统推算。

Kingdom of Cusco.name: Yáhuar Huácac
Kingdom of Cusco.note_zh: 传说中的君主，年代为传统推算。

Inca Empire.name: Pachacuti
Inca Empire.note: Turned the Kingdom of Cusco into an empire.
Inca Empire.note_zh: 将库斯科王国扩展为帝国。

Inca Empire.name: Huayna Cápac
Inca Empire.note: Died of smallpox brought by Europeans.
Inca Empire.note_zh: 死于欧洲人带来的天花。

Inca Empire.name: Huáscar
Inca Empire.note: Lost the civil war to his brother Atahualpa.
Inca Empire.note_zh: 在内战中败给兄弟阿塔瓦尔帕。

Inca Empire.name: Atahualpa
Inca Empire.note: Captured by Pizarro at Cajamarca and executed.
Inca Empire.note_zh: 在卡哈马卡被皮萨罗俘虏后处死。

Chimú.name: Minchancaman
Chimú.note: Last independent king, conquered by the Incas.
Chimú.note_zh: 最后一位独立的奇穆国王，被印加征服。

people.name: Pachacuti
people.known_for: Inca ruler who turned Cusco into the capital of a vast empire and is linked to Machu Picchu.
people.known_for_zh: 印加君主，把库斯科建成庞大帝国的首都，马丘比丘被认为是他的行宫。

people.name: Túpac Inca Yupanqui
people.known_for: Inca ruler who conquered Chimor and pushed the empire south into Chile.
people.known_for_zh: 印加君主，征服奇穆王国，把帝国疆域向南扩展到智利。

people.name: Huayna Cápac
people.known_for: Inca ruler under whom the empire reached its greatest size, ruling from Cusco and Quito.
people.known_for_zh: 印加君主，在位时帝国疆域达到顶峰，他常驻基多。

people.name: Atahualpa
people.known_for: Last Sapa Inca, who won the civil war but was captured and executed by Pizarro.
people.known_for_zh: 最后一位萨帕印卡，赢得内战后被皮萨罗俘虏并处死。

people.name: Pedro Álvares Cabral
people.name_zh: 佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·卡布拉尔
people.known_for: Portuguese navigator who reached Brazil in 1500 and claimed it for Portugal.
people.known_for_zh: 葡萄牙航海家，1500年到达巴西，宣布其归葡萄牙所有。

Viceroyalty of Peru.name: Charles I
Viceroyalty of Peru.note: Also Holy Roman Emperor as Charles V.
Viceroyalty of Peru.note_zh: 同时是神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理五世。

Portuguese Brazil.name: Philip I
Portuguese Brazil.note_zh: 即西班牙国王腓力二世。

Portuguese Brazil.name: Philip II
Portuguese Brazil.note_zh: 即西班牙国王腓力三世。

Portuguese Brazil.name: Philip III
Portuguese Brazil.note_zh: 即西班牙国王腓力四世。

Portuguese Brazil.name: Maria I
Portuguese Brazil.note: Her son John ruled as regent from 1792 and moved the court to Rio in 1808.
Portuguese Brazil.note_zh: 其子若昂自1792年摄政，1808年把宫廷迁到里约热内卢。

Neo-Inca State.name: Túpac Amaru
Neo-Inca State.note: Last Inca ruler, executed by the Spanish in Cusco.
Neo-Inca State.note_zh: 最后一位印加君主，在库斯科被西班牙人处死。

people.name: Francisco Pizarro
people.known_for: Spanish conquistador who conquered the Inca Empire and founded Lima in 1535.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙征服者，征服印加帝国，1535年建立利马城。

people.name: Diego de Almagro
people.known_for: Pizarro's partner who led the first Spanish expedition to Chile and was later killed by the Pizarros.
people.known_for_zh: 皮萨罗的合伙人，率领西班牙人首次远征智利，后被皮萨罗兄弟处死。

people.name: Manco Inca Yupanqui
people.known_for: Inca ruler who rose against the Spanish in 1536 and founded the Neo-Inca state at Vilcabamba.
people.known_for_zh: 印加君主，1536年起兵反抗西班牙人，在比尔卡班巴建立新印加国。

people.name: Francisco de Orellana
people.name_zh: 弗朗西斯科·德奥雷亚纳
people.known_for: Spanish explorer who made the first descent of the Amazon in 1542.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙探险家，1542年首次沿亚马孙河顺流而下直到大西洋。

people.name: Pedro de Valdivia
people.known_for: Conquistador who founded Santiago in 1541 and was killed in the Mapuche war.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙征服者，1541年建立智利圣地亚哥，后在与马普切人的战争中阵亡。

people.name: Gonzalo Jiménez de Quesada
people.name_zh: 冈萨洛·希门尼斯·德克萨达
people.known_for: Conquistador who conquered the Muisca and founded Bogotá in 1538.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙征服者，征服穆伊斯卡人，1538年建立波哥大。

people.name: Francisco de Toledo
people.known_for: Viceroy of Peru who organised the colonial system and the forced labour of the Potosí mines.
people.known_for_zh: 秘鲁总督，建立殖民统治体系，推行波托西银矿的强制劳役制度。

people.name: José de Anchieta
people.known_for: Jesuit missionary who helped found São Paulo and wrote the first grammar of the Tupi language.
people.known_for_zh: 耶稣会传教士，参与建立圣保罗，编写了第一部图皮语语法。

people.name: Inca Garcilaso de la Vega
people.name_zh: 印卡·加西拉索·德拉维加
people.known_for: Son of a Spanish captain and an Inca princess who wrote the classic history of the Incas.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙军官与印加公主之子，写下印加历史名著。

people.name: Felipe Guaman Poma de Ayala
people.known_for: Andean noble whose illustrated chronicle protested Spanish abuses.
people.known_for_zh: 安第斯贵族，所著配图编年史揭露西班牙人的暴政。

works.title: The First New Chronicle and Good Government

people.name: Rose of Lima
people.known_for: Lima mystic, the first saint born in the Americas.
people.known_for_zh: 利马的苦修女信徒，第一位出生于美洲的天主教圣人。

people.name: Peter Claver
people.known_for: Jesuit who cared for enslaved Africans arriving at Cartagena.
people.known_for_zh: 耶稣会传教士，在卡塔赫纳照料运来的非洲奴隶。

people.name: António Vieira
people.known_for: Jesuit preacher who defended the native peoples of Brazil, a master of Portuguese prose.
people.known_for_zh: 耶稣会布道家，维护巴西印第安人权利，是葡萄牙语散文大师。

people.name: Zumbi
people.known_for: Last leader of Palmares, the largest community of escaped slaves in Brazil.
people.known_for_zh: 巴西最大逃亡奴隶聚居地帕尔马雷斯的最后一位领袖，今天是黑人抗争的象征。

people.name: Aleijadinho
people.known_for: Sculptor and architect, the master of the Brazilian baroque.
people.known_for_zh: 雕塑家和建筑师，巴西巴洛克艺术的大师。

people.name: Túpac Amaru II
people.known_for: Leader of the great Andean rebellion of 1780 against Spanish rule.
people.known_for_zh: 1780年安第斯大起义的领袖，起义失败后在库斯科被处死。

people.name: Tiradentes
people.known_for: Leader of the 1789 plot for Brazilian independence in Minas Gerais, executed in Rio.
people.known_for_zh: 1789年米纳斯吉拉斯独立密谋的领袖，在里约热内卢被处死，被视为巴西民族英雄。

people.name: José Celestino Mutis
people.name_zh: 何塞·塞莱斯蒂诺·穆蒂斯
people.known_for: Spanish botanist who led the great botanical survey of New Granada.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙植物学家，主持新格拉纳达植物大考察。

Brazil.name: John VI
Brazil.note: Ruled the Portuguese empire from Rio de Janeiro.
Brazil.note_zh: 在里约热内卢统治葡萄牙帝国。

people.name: Simón Bolívar
people.known_for: The Liberator, who freed Venezuela, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru and Bolivia from Spanish rule.
people.known_for_zh: “解放者”，领导委内瑞拉、哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔、秘鲁和玻利维亚摆脱西班牙统治。

people.name: José de San Martín
people.known_for: Argentine general who crossed the Andes to free Chile and then proclaimed Peru's independence.
people.known_for_zh: 阿根廷将领，翻越安第斯山解放智利，随后宣布秘鲁独立。

people.name: Antonio José de Sucre
people.name_zh: 安东尼奥·何塞·德苏克雷
people.known_for: Bolívar's general who won the decisive Battle of Ayacucho in 1824, first president of Bolivia.
people.known_for_zh: 玻利瓦尔麾下将领，1824年赢得决定性的阿亚库乔战役，后任玻利维亚首任总统。

people.name: Bernardo O'Higgins
people.known_for: Leader of Chile's independence and its first head of state.
people.known_for_zh: 智利独立运动的领袖和第一位国家元首，被尊为智利国父。

people.name: Francisco de Miranda
people.known_for: Venezuelan revolutionary who led the first independent Venezuelan republic in 1811 to 1812.
people.known_for_zh: 委内瑞拉革命家，1811年至1812年领导委内瑞拉第一共和国，被称为“先驱者”。

people.name: Francisco de Paula Santander
people.name_zh: 弗朗西斯科·德保拉·桑坦德尔
people.known_for: Bolívar's vice-president who governed Gran Colombia and founded its schools and laws.
people.known_for_zh: 玻利瓦尔的副总统，实际治理大哥伦比亚，建立学校和法制。

people.name: Manuel Belgrano
people.known_for: Argentine independence leader who created the national flag.
people.known_for_zh: 阿根廷独立运动领袖，设计了阿根廷国旗。

people.name: José Gervasio Artigas
people.name_zh: 何塞·赫瓦西奥·阿蒂加斯
people.known_for: Leader of the Banda Oriental, honoured as the father of Uruguay.
people.known_for_zh: 东岸地区的独立领袖，被尊为乌拉圭国父。

people.name: José Bonifácio de Andrada
people.known_for: Scientist and minister who guided Pedro I to declare Brazil independent in 1822.
people.known_for_zh: 科学家和大臣，辅佐佩德罗一世于1822年宣布巴西独立，被称为“独立之父”。

people.name: Manuela Sáenz
people.known_for: Ecuadorian patriot and Bolívar's companion, who saved his life in 1828.
people.known_for_zh: 厄瓜多尔爱国者，玻利瓦尔的伴侣，1828年救了他的性命。

people.name: Juana Azurduy de Padilla
people.known_for: Guerrilla leader in Upper Peru who fought for independence.
people.known_for_zh: 上秘鲁（今玻利维亚）的游击队女领袖，为独立而战。

people.name: Mariano Moreno
people.known_for: Lawyer and journalist, a leader of the May Revolution of 1810 in Buenos Aires.
people.known_for_zh: 律师和报人，1810年布宜诺斯艾利斯“五月革命”的领导人之一。

Brazil.name: Pedro II
Brazil.note: Ruled through regents until 1840; deposed when the republic was proclaimed.
Brazil.note_zh: 1840年前由摄政代政，1889年共和国成立时被废黜。

Argentina.name: Bernardino Rivadavia
Argentina.name_zh: 贝尔纳迪诺·里瓦达维亚

Argentina.name: Juan Manuel de Rosas
Argentina.name_zh: 胡安·曼努埃尔·德罗萨斯

Argentina.name: Justo José de Urquiza
Argentina.name_zh: 胡斯托·何塞·德乌尔基萨

Argentina.name: Domingo Faustino Sarmiento
Argentina.name_zh: 多明戈·福斯蒂诺·萨缅托

Argentina.name: Nicolás Avellaneda
Argentina.name_zh: 尼古拉斯·阿韦利亚内达

Chile.name: José Manuel Balmaceda
Chile.name_zh: 何塞·曼努埃尔·巴尔马塞达

Chile.name: Carlos Ibáñez del Campo
Chile.name_zh: 卡洛斯·伊瓦涅斯·德尔坎波

people.name: Andrés Bello
people.known_for: Venezuelan scholar who wrote Chile's civil code and founded the University of Chile.
people.known_for_zh: 委内瑞拉学者，为智利起草民法典，创办智利大学，著有西班牙语语法。

people.name: Diego Portales
people.known_for: Chilean minister who built the strong, stable state of the 1830s.
people.known_for_zh: 智利部长，在1830年代建立了强大而稳定的国家体制。

people.name: Juan Manuel de Rosas
people.name_zh: 胡安·曼努埃尔·德罗萨斯
people.known_for: Caudillo who ruled Buenos Aires and dominated Argentina until 1852.
people.known_for_zh: 军事强人，统治布宜诺斯艾利斯并主宰阿根廷直到1852年。
states: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

people.name: Domingo Faustino Sarmiento
people.name_zh: 多明戈·福斯蒂诺·萨缅托
people.known_for: Writer and president who championed public schools in Argentina.
people.known_for_zh: 作家和总统，大力推广阿根廷公共教育。
states: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

people.name: Juan Bautista Alberdi
people.name_zh: 胡安·包蒂斯塔·阿尔韦迪
people.known_for: Political thinker whose ideas shaped the Argentine Constitution of 1853.
people.known_for_zh: 政治思想家，其主张奠定了1853年阿根廷宪法的基础。
states: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

people.name: Pedro II of Brazil
people.known_for: Scholarly emperor of Brazil for nearly 50 years, deposed in 1889.
people.known_for_zh: 博学的巴西皇帝，在位近50年，1889年被推翻。

people.name: Isabel, Princess Imperial of Brazil
people.known_for: Princess regent who signed the Golden Law of 1888 ending slavery in Brazil.
people.known_for_zh: 摄政公主，1888年签署《黄金法》，废除巴西奴隶制。

people.name: Joaquim Nabuco
people.known_for: Leading voice of the Brazilian abolitionist movement.
people.known_for_zh: 巴西废奴运动的主要领袖。

people.name: Francisco Solano López
people.name_zh: 弗朗西斯科·索拉诺·洛佩斯
people.known_for: Paraguayan ruler who led his country into the ruinous Paraguayan War of 1864 to 1870.
people.known_for_zh: 巴拉圭统治者，把国家拖入1864年至1870年的毁灭性巴拉圭战争。

people.name: Machado de Assis
people.known_for: Brazil's greatest novelist and founder of the Brazilian Academy of Letters.
people.known_for_zh: 巴西最伟大的小说家，巴西文学院的创始人。

works.title: The Posthumous Memoirs of Brás Cubas
works.title_zh: 布拉斯·库巴斯死后的回忆

people.name: José Hernández
people.known_for: Poet of the gaucho epic Martín Fierro.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人，著有高乔史诗《马丁·菲耶罗》。
states: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

people.name: Ricardo Palma
people.known_for: Peruvian writer of witty historical tales.
people.known_for_zh: 秘鲁作家，以诙谐的历史故事闻名，曾重建利马国家图书馆。

people.name: Jorge Isaacs
people.known_for: Colombian author of the romantic novel María.
people.known_for_zh: 哥伦比亚作家，著有浪漫主义小说《玛利亚》。

people.name: Euclides da Cunha
people.known_for: Brazilian writer who described the Canudos war in the backlands.
people.known_for_zh: 巴西作家，记述了腹地卡努杜斯战争。

people.name: Oswaldo Cruz
people.known_for: Doctor who rid Rio de Janeiro of yellow fever and founded Brazil's leading research institute.
people.known_for_zh: 医生，消除了里约热内卢的黄热病，创建巴西最重要的医学研究所。

people.name: Carlos Chagas
people.known_for: Brazilian doctor who discovered Chagas disease in 1909.
people.known_for_zh: 巴西医生，1909年发现以他命名的查加斯病。

people.name: José Enrique Rodó
people.known_for: Uruguayan essayist who urged Latin America to keep its own spiritual values.
people.known_for_zh: 乌拉圭散文家，呼吁拉丁美洲坚守自身的精神价值。

people.name: César Vallejo
people.known_for: Peruvian poet, one of the great innovators of 20th-century poetry.
people.known_for_zh: 秘鲁诗人，20世纪最具创新精神的诗人之一。

people.name: José Carlos Mariátegui
people.name_zh: 何塞·卡洛斯·马里亚特吉
people.known_for: Peruvian Marxist thinker who wrote on the Indian and land questions.
people.known_for_zh: 秘鲁马克思主义思想家，深入研究印第安人和土地问题。

works.title: Seven Interpretative Essays on Peruvian Reality
works.title_zh: 关于秘鲁国情的七篇论文

people.name: Gabriela Mistral
people.known_for: Chilean poet and teacher, the first Latin American to win the Nobel Prize in Literature, in 1945.
people.known_for_zh: 智利诗人和教师，1945年成为第一位获诺贝尔文学奖的拉丁美洲作家。

people.name: Carlos Gardel
people.known_for: Singer who made tango famous around the world.
people.known_for_zh: 歌手，使探戈风靡世界，被称为“探戈之王”。

Brazil.name: Getúlio Vargas
Brazil.note: Ruled as dictator of the Estado Novo from 1937.

Brazil.name: Eurico Gaspar Dutra
Brazil.name_zh: 欧里科·加斯帕尔·杜特拉

Brazil.name: Humberto Castelo Branco
Brazil.name_zh: 温贝托·卡斯特洛·布兰科

Brazil.name: Artur da Costa e Silva
Brazil.name_zh: 阿图尔·达科斯塔-席尔瓦

Brazil.name: Emílio Garrastazu Médici
Brazil.name_zh: 埃米利奥·加拉斯塔祖·梅迪西

Argentina.name: José Félix Uriburu
Argentina.name_zh: 何塞·费利克斯·乌里武鲁

Argentina.name: Agustín P. Justo
Argentina.name_zh: 阿古斯丁·佩德罗·胡斯托

Chile.name: Carlos Ibáñez del Campo
Chile.name_zh: 卡洛斯·伊瓦涅斯·德尔坎波

Chile.name: Eduardo Frei Montalva
Chile.name_zh: 爱德华多·弗雷·蒙塔尔瓦

Venezuela.name: Marcos Pérez Jiménez
Venezuela.name_zh: 马科斯·佩雷斯·希门内斯

Venezuela.name: Carlos Andrés Pérez
Venezuela.name_zh: 卡洛斯·安德烈斯·佩雷斯

Venezuela.name: Carlos Andrés Pérez
Venezuela.name_zh: 卡洛斯·安德烈斯·佩雷斯

people.name: Getúlio Vargas
people.known_for: Populist leader who ruled Brazil for nearly 20 years and built its modern state.
people.known_for_zh: 民粹主义领袖，统治巴西近20年，奠定了现代巴西国家体制。

people.name: Juan Perón
people.known_for: Argentine president whose movement for workers, Peronism, still shapes the country.
people.known_for_zh: 阿根廷总统，以工人为基础的“庇隆主义”至今影响阿根廷政治。

people.name: Eva Perón
people.known_for: Wife of Perón, champion of the poor and of women's suffrage in Argentina.
people.known_for_zh: 庇隆的妻子，关怀穷人，推动阿根廷妇女获得选举权。

people.name: Salvador Allende
people.known_for: Socialist president of Chile who died in the military coup of 1973.
people.known_for_zh: 智利社会党总统，1973年死于军事政变。

people.name: Juscelino Kubitschek
people.known_for: Brazilian president who built the new capital Brasília.
people.known_for_zh: 巴西总统，主持修建新首都巴西利亚。

people.name: Che Guevara
people.known_for: Argentine revolutionary who fought in the Cuban Revolution and was killed in Bolivia.
people.known_for_zh: 阿根廷出生的革命家，参加古巴革命，1967年在玻利维亚被杀。

people.name: Jorge Luis Borges
people.name_zh: 豪尔赫·路易斯·博尔赫斯
people.known_for: Argentine writer of short stories about labyrinths, mirrors and infinity.
people.known_for_zh: 阿根廷作家，短篇小说中充满迷宫、镜子和无限的意象。

people.name: Pablo Neruda
people.known_for: Chilean poet of love and of the Americas, Nobel Prize in Literature 1971.
people.known_for_zh: 智利诗人，写爱情也写美洲，1971年获诺贝尔文学奖。

works.title: Twenty Love Poems and a Song of Despair
works.title_zh: 二十首情诗和一首绝望的歌

people.name: Gabriel García Márquez
people.name_zh: 加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯
people.known_for: Colombian novelist of magical realism, Nobel Prize in Literature 1982.
people.known_for_zh: 哥伦比亚作家，魔幻现实主义代表，1982年获诺贝尔文学奖。

works.title: Love in the Time of Cholera

people.name: Julio Cortázar
people.known_for: Argentine writer of the Latin American Boom.
people.known_for_zh: 阿根廷作家，拉丁美洲“文学爆炸”的代表人物。

people.name: Mario Vargas Llosa
people.known_for: Peruvian novelist of the Boom, Nobel Prize in Literature 2010.
people.known_for_zh: 秘鲁作家，“文学爆炸”代表人物，2010年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: Jorge Amado
people.known_for: Brazilian novelist of life in Bahia.
people.known_for_zh: 巴西小说家，描写巴伊亚的风土人情。

people.name: Clarice Lispector
people.known_for: Brazilian writer of inward, poetic fiction.
people.known_for_zh: 巴西作家，以内省而富有诗意的小说著称。

people.name: Oscar Niemeyer
people.known_for: Architect of the curving modernist buildings of Brasília.
people.known_for_zh: 建筑师，设计了巴西利亚极具曲线美的现代主义建筑。

people.name: Heitor Villa-Lobos
people.known_for: Brazil's best-known composer, who blended folk music with European forms.
people.known_for_zh: 巴西最著名的作曲家，把民间音乐与欧洲古典形式相融合。

people.name: Paulo Freire
people.known_for: Brazilian educator who taught literacy as a path to freedom.
people.known_for_zh: 巴西教育家，主张把扫盲教育作为解放的途径。

people.name: Raúl Prebisch
people.known_for: Argentine economist of the centre and periphery theory who led the UN Economic Commission for Latin America.
people.known_for_zh: 阿根廷经济学家，提出“中心外围”理论，领导联合国拉丁美洲经济委员会。

people.name: Violeta Parra
people.known_for: Chilean folk singer whose song Gracias a la vida became a Latin American anthem.
people.known_for_zh: 智利民歌手，她的歌曲《感谢生命》传唱整个拉丁美洲。

people.name: Víctor Jara
people.known_for: Chilean singer of the New Song movement, killed after the 1973 coup.
people.known_for_zh: 智利“新歌运动”歌手，1973年政变后遇害。

people.name: Astor Piazzolla
people.known_for: Composer who created the new tango.
people.known_for_zh: 作曲家，开创了“新探戈”。

people.name: Gustavo Gutiérrez
people.known_for: Peruvian priest who founded liberation theology.
people.known_for_zh: 秘鲁神父，解放神学的创始人。

people.name: Chico Mendes
people.known_for: Rubber tapper who fought to save the Amazon forest and was murdered in 1988.
people.known_for_zh: 橡胶采集工人，为保护亚马孙雨林而斗争，1988年遇害。

Brazil.name: Fernando Collor de Mello
Brazil.name_zh: 费尔南多·科洛尔·德梅洛

Brazil.name: Fernando Henrique Cardoso
Brazil.name_zh: 费尔南多·恩里克·卡多佐

Brazil.name: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva
Brazil.name_zh: 路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦

Brazil.name: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva
Brazil.name_zh: 路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦

Argentina.name: Cristina Fernández de Kirchner
Argentina.name_zh: 克里斯蒂娜·费尔南德斯·德基什内尔

Chile.name: Eduardo Frei Ruiz-Tagle
Chile.name_zh: 爱德华多·弗雷·鲁伊斯-塔格莱

Venezuela.name: Carlos Andrés Pérez
Venezuela.name_zh: 卡洛斯·安德烈斯·佩雷斯

Venezuela.name: Nicolás Maduro
Venezuela.note: Seized by US forces in January 2026.

people.name: Hugo Chávez
people.known_for: Venezuelan president who led a socialist 'Bolivarian Revolution' funded by oil.
people.known_for_zh: 委内瑞拉总统，依靠石油收入推行社会主义“玻利瓦尔革命”。

people.name: Sebastián Piñera
people.known_for: Businessman who was twice president of Chile and oversaw the rescue of 33 trapped miners in 2010.
people.known_for_zh: 企业家出身，两度出任智利总统，2010年主持营救33名被困矿工。

people.name: Carlos Menem
people.known_for: Argentine president who privatised state firms and pegged the peso to the dollar.
people.known_for_zh: 阿根廷总统，推行国企私有化，实行比索与美元挂钩。

people.name: Alberto Fujimori
people.known_for: Peruvian president of Japanese descent who defeated the Shining Path but was jailed for abuses.
people.known_for_zh: 日裔秘鲁总统，击败“光辉道路”游击队，后因侵犯人权等罪行入狱。

people.name: José Mujica
people.known_for: Former guerrilla who as president of Uruguay was known for his simple life.
people.known_for_zh: 前游击队员，任乌拉圭总统期间以生活简朴闻名，被称为“最穷总统”。

people.name: Fernando Botero
people.known_for: Colombian painter and sculptor famous for his rounded, swollen figures.
people.known_for_zh: 哥伦比亚画家和雕塑家，以造型圆润丰满的人物闻名。
